which simply means that behind the scenes,
it will automatically check for upgrades
that can be installed without requiring a
system restart, and it will apply those
upgrades right away then to keep your system
patched up. You still
may need to install certain updates yourself
and restart the server from time to time,
but it will
do some basic updating behind the scenes
automatically. That's the idea.

enabled properly for that package by running
sudo cat
